name: gev, scaled scorch
mana cost: {B}{R}
types: legendary creature lizard mercenary
power toughness: 3/2
static: ward—pay 2 life.
replacement: other creatures you control enter with an additional +1/+1 counter on them for each opponent who lost life this turn.
triggered: whenever you cast a lizard spell, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to target opponent.
